records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single full-body monster concept for a dark fairytale mobile game, hand-painted gouache and expressive dark ink, muted aged paper background, no words, no UI. Image1 is source rig proportions and four-legged pose ONLY, image2 is painterly style ONLY, DO NOT add mushrooms or thorns from image2. Redesign image1 into an unmistakable FRENZIED SQUIRREL, facing LEFT in three-quarter side view. Compact hunched furry quadruped, short rounded rodent muzzle, tiny nose, bulging squirrel cheeks, paired broad chisel incisors instead of wolf fangs, small tufted ears, four complete clawed paws. Very large SINGLE upright bushy plume tail behind on RIGHT, rising above head, gently curved and tapered, no separate curled donut or extra limbs. Keep silhouette ratio tail about half total silhouette height, stout body, overlarge head. Tense crouching lunge-ready posture, deranged alarmed expression but still grotesquely cute, mild uncanny horror, no blood or exposed wounds. Clearly show connections and joints, leave margin around all extremities. Soft warm upperleft light, ground shadow only. Rusty chestnut and warm cream fur, asymmetrically swollen nut-stuffed cheeks with faint acorn-shell contours under fur, two enormous slightly uneven ivory incisors, pinprick reddish amber pupils surrounded by pale sclera, crazed greedy wide stare. A little dark amber acorn sap at mouth corner, rigid bristling dorsal fur and huge unruly chestnut tail. Cheeks visibly look too full, mouth still opens slightly in a feral grin. Fur ruff replaces source metal collar. No held props. The uncanny theme is compulsive hoarding, not gore.
